method.mesh: one feature-preserving longest-edge bisection pass (2x triangles); new vertices stay on the source surface; UVs, normals and skin weights are interpolated
method.texture: diffuse color atlases (including weapon maps) are scaled up to 1.5x (maximum side 2048) with a restrained unsharp mask and 192-color palette; effect, mirror and gloss maps keep source dimensions in a dithered 128-color palette; alpha is retained, with RGBA PNG fallback for partially transparent images that have no fully transparent texels
method.art_direction: source geometry, palette and UVs are not repainted or reshaped
